title: The Impact of Voluntary Labeling
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Firm side (Section 3, 'Replication Code LI Regressions.R'): product-level cross-sectional regressions of sugar per 100 g on hfcs_dummy (product carries a 'no HFCS' label) with year, year-month, product-category and brand FE, by category, on matched product data (data_matched.Rdata); no product FE and no within-product switching. Consumer side (Section 4, Replication_Ketchup.R and Replication_Cereal.R): randomized online shopping experiment regressing purchase and search outcomes on factor(treatment) and treatment x respondent-characteristic interactions.
design_notes: R lfe::felm. Firm data: 24 product categories of new-product introductions (data_matched.Rdata per category); consumer data: experiment exports (xlsx/csv).
data_files_note: Processed matched product data and experiment data shipped; raw product databases too large and not included (Readme.docx).
screener_notes: Screened from package, Readme.docx and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). Cross-sectional label comparison plus RCT.
